title: Power charge
wikitext:
{{status
| name                   = Power Charge
| type                   = Charge
| description = Players gain increased Critical Strike Chance for each Power Charge they have
| bonuses                = {{#cargo_query: tables=generic_stats
|fields = stat_text
|where = name="Character" AND id LIKE "%power_charge%" AND id NOT LIKE "%max%"
|format = ul
}}
}}

'''Power charges''' are one of the three basic [[charge]] types. They are associated with [[intelligence]] and represent an increase to concentration and arcane energies during combat. They are visualized as glowing blue orbs surrounding the character. Gaining a new power charge resets the duration of all remaining power charges.

__TOC__

==Effects on monsters==
The effects of power charges are much more significant on (non-minion) [[monster]]s.
* 200% increased [[Critical Strike Chance]] per [[Power Charge]]

===Other interactions with power charges===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
    (item_stats.id LIKE "%power_charge%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%gain%power_charge%"  
    AND item_stats.id NOT IN ("max_power_charges", "power_charge_duration_+%")
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%per%power_charge%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%power_charge%on_kill%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%power_charge%on_stun%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%power_charge%on_using%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%power_charge%on%skill%use%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%gain_power_charges_on_use%"
    AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%maximum_power_charges_+_while_affected_by_discipline%"
    AND items.name NOT LIKE "Bound By Destiny"
    AND items.name NOT LIKE "Grand Spectrum")
    OR items.name = "The Devourer of Minds"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.21.0|
* Power Charges now provide 50% increased Critical Strike Chance per Power Charge for players and minions (previously 40%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.19.0|
* Minions now gain the same bonuses from Endurance, Frenzy and Power Charges as players do, rather than the significantly elevated bonuses that other Monsters gain.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.0.0|
* Power Charges now grant 40% increased Critical Strike Chance per Charge (down from 50%).
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.6|
* Changed Power Charges to add 2% overall [[critical strike chance]] per charge.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.5|
* Improved the [[mana regen]] per power charge passive.
* Improved Frenzy Charges from 4% to 5% [[attack speed]].
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.2|
* You can only gain one charge of each type per action now. (Only applied to frenzy charges, [[power charge]]s, and [[endurance charge]]s)
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.1|
* You can now only gain one charge of each type per action you perform, all stats gained per active charge are now slightly worse. (Only applied to [[frenzy charge]]s, power charges, and [[endurance charge]]s).
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.0|
* Introduced to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
